## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Paṭisandahanapañha* ("The Question on Awareness of the Ending of Rebirth") is a section of the *Milindapañha* [SuttaCentral]. Modern translations of the text include an English translation by John Kelly, as part of four translations available across three languages [SuttaCentral].
A full parallel to the dialogue is preserved in the Chinese translation of the *Milindapañha* literature at T 1670b 2.17 under the title "Knowledge of Having Rebirth" [SuttaCentral]. In terms of text reuse, automated analysis by DharmaNexus identifies 35 matching passages shared across six Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. These predominantly comprise close internal parallels within other sections of the *Milindapañha*, such as the *Paṭisandahanapuggalavediyanapañha* (Mil 3.2.4), the *Asaṅkamanapaṭisandahanapañha* (Mil 3.5.5), the *Uppajjatijānanapañha* (Mil 3.5.9), and the *Nāmarūpapaṭisandahanapañha* (Mil 3.2.8), in addition to shared segments found in late Vinaya exegetical treatises including the *Khuddasikkhā-mūlasikkhā* and the *Vinayasaṅgaha-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus].
*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
